name: Gothic Folly 2026
about: The Gothic Folly is a full-scale LED cathedral built for Burning Man: a playa-facing portal of five main arches, mini arches left and right, six quad arches, four spires, spirelets (flood-lit cones), a 16-petal rose window with 7 rings of cells, a canopy overhead and a ground wash of 22 floods.
